items: 【Smart Control at Your Fingertips with an Intuitive LED Screen】 Cleaning becomes an intelligent experience with our vibrant LED touch screen. Stay in complete control with real-time updates on the current suction mode, remaining battery life, and any maintenance alerts. A simple touch lets you switch power modes seamlessly. Plus, the included wall-mounted storage bracket keeps your vacuum and accessories neatly stored and always within reach, saving valuable floor space.

items.label: 【Whole-Home Hygiene
items.value: Advanced Filtration & Easy Emptying】 Breathe easier knowing our 6-stage advanced filtration system captures 99.99% of microscopic particles down to 0.3 microns, including fine dust and pet dander. The large-capacity dust cup means fewer trips to the trash can, and the one-touch empty mechanism releases debris quickly and hygienically, ensuring your hands never have to touch the dirt.

items: 【Powerful & Adaptable Suction for Deep Cleans】Our cordless vacuum cleaner equips your home with the cleaning power of our upgraded brushless motor. Choose from 3 intelligently adjustable suction levels to match your task: Echo Mode (12kPa/40Mins) for gentle, everyday cleaning, Mid Mode (20kPa/25Mins) for standard dirt and Max Mode (30KPa/15Mins) to unleash our maximum power. This mode easily tackles the toughest messes, like deeply embedded pet hair, crushed cat litter, and cereal crumbs from carpets, while still being gentle enough for your hardwood floors and tiles.

【Lightweight & Self-Standing, Always Ready to Go】 Weighing next to nothing and featuring an innovative self-standing design, this vacuum cleaner for home is your ultimate grab-and-go cleaning companion. It stands upright independently anywhere – no more leaning it against the wall or searching for a place to park it. This frees your hands instantly, whether you're answering the door mid-clean or tidying up a cluttered room. The ergonomic handle ensures comfortable, one-handed operation, making it a breeze for everyone in the family, from busy parents and apartment dwellers to students and seniors, to keep their space spotless.

【LED Lights & 180° Flexible Brush Head】 Don't let dirt lurk in the shadows. Our upgraded floor brush is equipped with 4 powerful LED headlights that shine a light on hidden debris under your sofa, bed, and furniture. The brush head's 180° flexible swivel and 90° tilt allows it to glide effortlessly around table legs and into tight corners, ensuring a comprehensive clean across your entire home.

items.label: 【From Ceiling to Carpet
items.value: A 6-in-1 Cleaning Arsenal】 More than just a stick vacuum, it's a complete cleaning system. The included 2-in-1 brush, crevice tool, and extendable metal tube easily convert your vacuum to tackle any scenario. Quickly transform it into a handheld vacuum to clean the car interior, staircase, and sofa, or use the long-reach mode for ceiling corners and curtain rails. This versatility makes it an ideal, thoughtful gift for pet owners, new homeowners, and anyone who values a truly clean home.

items: 【Professional Customer Support】Every vacuum cleaner is built with strict quality control to ensure it delivers a premium cleaning experience for years to come. Should you have any questions or need assistance, our dedicated customer support team is ready to provide fast solutions.
